<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config.php';

// Classic PayPal NVP (name-value pair) API client.
function paypal_nvp($method, array $params = []) {
    $post = array_merge([
        'USER'      => PAYPAL_API_USERNAME,
        'PWD'       => PAYPAL_API_PASSWORD,
        'SIGNATURE' => PAYPAL_API_SIGNATURE,
        'VERSION'   => PAYPAL_NVP_VERSION,
        'METHOD'    => $method,
    ], $params);

    $ch = curl_init(PAYPAL_NVP_ENDPOINT);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($post));
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 30);
    $raw = curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);

    parse_str((string)$raw, $out);
    return $out;   // e.g. ['ACK' => 'Success', 'TOKEN' => 'EC-...']
}

function paypal_ok($r) {
    return isset($r['ACK']) && ($r['ACK'] === 'Success' || $r['ACK'] === 'SuccessWithWarning');
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';

use PaypalServerSdkLib\PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Authentication\ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Environment;
use PaypalServerSdkLib\ApiException;

$clientId = PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID;
$clientSecret = PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET;

$client = null;
$orders = null;
$payments = null;

if ($clientId && $clientSecret) {
    try {
        $client = PaypalServerSdkClientBuilder::init()
            ->clientCredentialsAuthCredentials(ClientCredentialsAuthCredentialsBuilder::init($clientId, $clientSecret))
            ->environment(Environment::SANDBOX)->build();
        $orders = $client->getOrdersController();
        $payments = $client->getPaymentsController();
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("PayPal SDK client initialization failed: " . $e->getMessage());
        // Client will remain null, calling scripts must check for it.
    }
} else {
    error_log("PayPal API credentials (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID or PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET) are missing.");
}

// Helper function for API calls to handle exceptions consistently
function handlePayPalApiException($e) {
    if ($e instanceof ApiException) {
        $statusCode = $e->getStatusCode();
        $responseBody = $e->getResponseBody();
        error_log("PayPal API Error (Status: $statusCode): $responseBody");
        $errorData = json_decode($responseBody, true);
        $errorMessage = $errorData['message'] ?? ($errorData['details'][0]['description'] ?? 'PayPal API error');
        http_response_code(502);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $errorMessage]);
    } else {
        error_log("Unexpected error: " . $e->getMessage());
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'An unexpected error occurred.']);
    }
    exit;
}

// Helper function for admin authentication
function authenticateAdmin() {
    $adminToken = ADMIN_TOKEN;
    $requestToken = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_ADMIN_TOKEN'] ?? '';

    if (!$adminToken) {
        error_log("ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is not set.");
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Admin token not configured on server.']);
        exit;
    }

    if ($requestToken !== $adminToken) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unauthorized.']);
        exit;
    }
}

<?php
// MIGRATED: Replaces legacy IPN listener with a modern Webhook handler.
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/orders_store.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/paypal_sdk.php'; // For error handling and logging
header('Content-Type: application/json');

$webhookId = PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID;
if (!$webhookId) {
    error_log("PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID environment variable is not set.");
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Webhook ID not configured.']);
    exit;
}

$rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');
$headers = getallheaders();

// Extract PayPal webhook headers
$paypalHeaders = [
    'PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'      => $headers['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Auth-Algo'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-CERT-URL'       => $headers['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Cert-Url'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Id'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Sig'] ?? '',
    'PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'=> $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'] ?? $headers['Paypal-Transmission-Time'] ?? '',
];

// Check if all required headers are present
foreach ($paypalHeaders as $key => $value) {
    if (empty($value)) {
        error_log("Missing PayPal webhook header: $key");
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => "Missing PayPal webhook header: $key"]);
        exit;
    }
}

$event = json_decode($rawBody, true);
if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
    error_log("Invalid JSON payload: " . json_last_error_msg());
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON payload.']);
    exit;
}

// Verify webhook signature
function verifyWebhookSignature($webhookId, $paypalHeaders, $rawBody) {
    $clientId = PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID;
    $clientSecret = PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET;

    if (!$clientId || !$clientSecret) {
        error_log("PayPal API credentials not configured for webhook verification.");
        return false;
    }

    // First, get an access token
    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERPWD, $clientId . ':' . $clientSecret);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, 'grant_type=client_credentials');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Accept: application/json', 'Accept-Language: en_US']);
    $tokenResponse = curl_exec($ch);
    $tokenHttpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($tokenHttpCode !== 200) {
        error_log("Failed to get access token for webhook verification: HTTP $tokenHttpCode - $tokenResponse");
        return false;
    }
    $tokenData = json_decode($tokenResponse, true);
    $accessToken = $tokenData['access_token'] ?? null;

    if (!$accessToken) {
        error_log("Access token not found in response for webhook verification.");
        return false;
    }

    // Then, verify the webhook signature
    $verifyBody = [
        'auth_algo'         => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'],
        'cert_url'          => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'],
        'transmission_id'   => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'],
        'transmission_sig'  => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'],
        'transmission_time' => $paypalHeaders['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'],
        'webhook_id'        => $webhookId,
        'webhook_event'     => json_decode($rawBody) // Must be a JSON object, not string
    ];

    $ch = curl_init('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature');
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
        'Content-Type: application/json',
        'Authorization: Bearer ' . $accessToken
    ]);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($verifyBody));

    $verifyResponse = curl_exec($ch);
    $verifyHttpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($verifyHttpCode !== 200) {
        error_log("Webhook verification failed: HTTP $verifyHttpCode - $verifyResponse");
        return false;
    }

    $verifyData = json_decode($verifyResponse, true);
    return ($verifyData['verification_status'] ?? '') === 'SUCCESS';
}

if (!verifyWebhookSignature($webhookId, $paypalHeaders, $rawBody)) {
    error_log("Webhook signature verification failed.");
    http_response_code(403); // Forbidden
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Webhook signature verification failed.']);
    exit;
}

// Process the event
$eventType = $event['event_type'] ?? '';
$resource = $event['resource'] ?? [];
$eventId = $event['id'] ?? ''; // For duplicate checking

// Log the event for debugging (optional, but good for webhooks)
file_put_contents(__DIR__ . '/data/webhook.log', date('c') . ' ' . $eventType . ' ' . $eventId . "\n", FILE_APPEND);

switch ($eventType) {
    case 'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED':
        $captureId = $resource['id'] ?? null;
        $orderId = $resource['supplementary_data']['related_ids']['order_id'] ?? null;
        $amountValue = $resource['amount']['value'] ?? null;
        $currencyCode = $resource['amount']['currency_code'] ?? null;

        if (!$captureId || !$orderId || !$amountValue || !$currencyCode) {
            error_log("Missing data in PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event: " . json_encode($event));
            http_response_code(400);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing data in webhook event.']);
            exit;
        }

        $order = orders_get($orderId);

        if (!$order) {
            error_log("Order $orderId not found for capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            // Respond 200 to PayPal to avoid retries, but log the issue.
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Order not found, logged for review.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Idempotency check: ignore if already processed or refunded
        if ($order['status'] === 'PAID' && $order['transaction_id'] === $captureId) {
            error_log("Duplicate PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event for order $orderId, capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Already processed.']);
            exit;
        }
        if ($order['status'] === 'REFUNDED') {
            error_log("PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event for already refunded order $orderId, capture $captureId. Event ID: $eventId");
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Order already refunded.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Verify amount and currency (security check)
        if (number_format((float)$order['amount'], 2, '.', '') !== number_format((float)$amountValue, 2, '.', '') || $order['currency'] !== $currencyCode) {
            error_log("Amount/currency mismatch for order $orderId. Expected {$order['amount']} {$order['currency']}, got $amountValue $currencyCode. Event ID: $eventId");
            // This is a critical error, might indicate fraud or misconfiguration.
            // Respond 200 to PayPal to avoid retries, but alert human.
            http_response_code(200);
            echo json_encode(['status' => 'Amount/currency mismatch, logged for review.']);
            exit;
        }

        // Update order status
        $order['status'] = 'PAID';
        $order['transaction_id'] = $captureId;
        // Payer details are not directly in PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, but can be fetched from the order if needed.
        // For now, keep existing or fetch from orders->getOrder() if needed.
        orders_save($order);

        http_response_code(200);
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'success']);
        break;

    // Add other event types if needed (e.g., PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED)
    default:
        error_log("Unhandled webhook event type: $eventType. Event ID: $eventId");
        http_response_code(200); // Acknowledge to avoid retries for unhandled events
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'Unhandled event type.']);
        break;
}

with an empty cart the buyer sees nothing after clicking the PayPal button. Show a visible message in #result (for example 'Payment failed: your cart is empty') and do not open PayPal or create an order; catch the rejected promise so no uncaught error is thrown.

mistakes.detail: The AI called getNotificationsController()->verifyWebhookSignature(). That method does not exist in PayPal's PHP SDK.
mistakes.caught: SDK guard: every controller the code calls is looked up in the installed package.
mistakes.fixed: Rewritten with PayPal's REST verify-webhook-signature endpoint.

mistakes.detail: It awaited the order creation before opening PayPal, so the browser blocked the PayPal window.
mistakes.caught: Browser smoke test: a real Chrome clicks the button and the PayPal window must open.
mistakes.fixed: start() is now called synchronously with the order promise.

mistakes.detail: Every product went to PayPal, including quantity 0. PayPal refuses those, and the error came back as an HTML page.
mistakes.caught: Contract check with the cart the page really sends.
mistakes.fixed: Zero-quantity items skipped; errors returned as JSON.

mistakes.detail: config.php stopped on load when an optional webhook setting was missing, so every page showed an error.
mistakes.fixed: Optional settings are only required where they are used.

mistakes.detail: A cheaper fallback model deleted the quantity inputs and the cancel message.
mistakes.caught: Contract check: the page must keep its cart inputs and cancel handling.

mistakes.what: Read the wrong field in the webhook event
mistakes.detail: The AI looked for the order id at supplementary_data.related_resources[0].order.id. Real PayPal capture events put it at supplementary_data.related_ids.order_id, so the handler answered HTTP 400 to every real event.
mistakes.caught: The first real sandbox webhook after deploy: PayPal logged a delivery failure. Offline checks cannot see real events.
mistakes.fixed: The fact went into the grounding and a static check now guards it. The next migration read the right field on its own.
